title: [3.0-beta5] Problem with temporary basals
body:
AAPS 3.0-beta5

On many occasions, the calculation that he makes of the temporary basal is immensely high.

I think this problem may be the one causing the problem in the statistics that I recently reported in the following ticket: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/859

I add a screenshot where you can see the problem:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67511778/141643514-2c1dc704-e905-4d0e-9a94-48b1e4c793f3.png)

Regards,

Fran.

comments.body:
This seems like problem with your setup (NS).

Marked entry looks like some sort of daily total... 55 U, looks like your daily dose... 

Upper 3 entries all look like they are happening at same time... 

On which pump does this happen?

Hello,

I am using Accu-Check Insight.

This problem occurs in both version 3.0-beta5 and dev version 2.8.2.10-dev. Yesterday I updated to the dev version in case the problem had been corrected, I reset the database and I have seen that the same thing continues to happen.

In stable version 2.8.2 it has never happened to me, only in betas and dev.

My basals are in this range: 0.27-0.45 and my multipliers in AAPS are x3 and x4, so I don't understand how I can get to those values.
